description: 국가철도공단_코레일_고객센터 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 코레일에서 관리하는 도시광역철도역들의 고객센터 정보를 포함하고 있으며, 철도운영기관명, 노선명, 역명, 지상·지하 구분, 역 층수, 상세 위치와 고객센터 전화번호 등 이용자 편의를. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 상세위치, 코레일지하철, 전화번호, 운영기관. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
